0022600180.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (5-2, 3-0 at home, 2nd in the Northwest and 0.5 games back) host the Cleveland Cavaliers (4-3, 2nd in the Central and 2 games back) with the Thunder riding a one-game winning streak. Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), Nikola Topic (back) and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness). The Thunder lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 and won the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 117-112 win in Cleveland on November 2, 2026, their most recent meeting.
